audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability facts. spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] both credit the wall vault to 'Cutthroat (E)' — Talon has no ability called Cutthroat; his E is Assassin's Path. Both also put the reset on Rake (W); Rake is the dagger volley, and the only refund in the kit is on Noxian Diplomacy (Q), which returns health and cooldown ONLY if the Q kills the target.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.' Riot's Q text: 'Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.' Riot's W text: returning blades deal bonus damage and slow — no reset, no knockup.
audit.corrected: Assassin's Path named for the vault, the Q kill-refund stated as a kill condition, and the used-terrain lockout — the single most actionable fact in this matchup — written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' is used as Aurelion Sol's level-6 spike in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid, and wants.you[3] says to 'poke aggressively with R'. Worse, whys[4] argues Aurelion Sol wins level 6 while win[4] says Talon.
audit.why: Voice of Light is the pre-rework ultimate. The current R is Falling Star — 1250 range, 120/110/100s, a stun, not poke. Talon's level-6 spike is Shadow Assault at 100/80/60s, 550 range, invisibility with converging blades. On cooldowns alone he gets it back faster than you do.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten in both layers around Falling Star's 120s against Shadow Assault's 100s, and whys[4]/phases[4].why now both argue for Talon, matching win[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side reads 'Skill' while win[6] reads 'Aurelion Sol' — the two layers render different answers for the 2+ items row. The packet also flags the chart as contradicting the 54.26% win rate.
audit.why: phases[6].why already says 'You are the scaling endgame', so the full layer contradicted itself as well as the content layer. packet.levelChart agrees with the content row (Talon x5 then Aurelion Sol x2), and that shape is coherent for an assassin against a hyperscaler even at a 54% overall win rate, so I moved only the disagreeing row.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side set to 'Aurelion Sol'. Rows 0-5 left exactly as they are — I could not justify moving them from the kits, and the packet chart backs them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet reports sequencingCues: 0 and 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 3 plus a packet defect. Every number is in the kit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around Assassin's Path (free, but the used wall locks out), Rake 9s at rank 1 / 650, Noxian Diplomacy 8s / 575 with the leap outside melee. Concrete 'wait for X' lines added to dosFull[2].d (Shadow Assault 100s), dontsFull[2].d (Rake 9s) and report[5].t (step up on the wall lockout).

audit.why: Defect catalogue item 2, plus a stale kit reference — Breath of Light is a channelled beam, not a projectile.
audit.corrected: Both bleeds replaced with bodies that match their titles; the projectile phrasing removed.

notes:
KIT FLAG MISFIRES:
1. ownerKit W (Astral Flight) carries terrain='creates terrain'. Riot says Aurelion Sol FLIES OVER terrain and creates none. Same false flag as on the sylas, syndra and taliyah briefs — it is systematic for this champion and the rule generator should be fixed before it produces a 'your W walls off their dash' headline.
2. enemyKit W (Rake) carries a knockup flag. Riot's text says the returning blades deal bonus damage and SLOW. There is no displacement in Rake. I wrote slow/damage only.
3. enemyKit E (Assassin's Path) carries terrain='creates terrain'. He vaults over terrain; he creates none. The real mechanic — the vaulted wall going on a long cooldown — is the opposite of what that flag implies, and it is the best piece of information in this matchup.

PACKET SUSPECT NAMES ARE BOTH FALSE POSITIVES: 'Use Shadow Assault' in wants.foe[2] and 'His Shadow Assault' in late are the correct name for Talon's R. Left untouched. The genuine fabricated name was 'Cutthroat (E)' in spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0], which the near-miss detector did not catch because it is a real old ability name rather than a typo.

CHART: phases[6].side ('Skill') disagreed with win[6] ('Aurelion Sol') and with its own why. Fixed. The packet flags the whole chart as contradicting a 54.26% win rate, but Talon-early / Aurelion-Sol-late is exactly what both kits say and the packet's own levelChart matches the content layer, so I left rows 0-5 alone rather than invent a swing. Recorded here per the chart rule.

UNVERIFIED / LEFT ALONE: whether Falling Star reveals or hits Talon during Shadow Assault's invisibility, and whether Astral Flight can be interrupted by Rake's slow. Nothing in the kits answers either, so no text asserts either way. mid says to hold the stun until the blades converge, which is true regardless of the reveal question.
